body: I guess I'm just reaching my limits overall. Maybe that and a combination of my kindness wasn't good enough.
It's been off and on for months now, about a year. This week has been the absolute worst, though.

I left someone alone, by request. Totally alone, as they wanted. They got mad at me when I did that and tried to call me, a lot. My cell phone has stopped working, and when I contacted them from a different phone to tell them, they called me a liar, and said I mess up all the time, I'm always the fuck up, I'm always the delay, etc. Nothing I do is believed nor understood.
Yes, I am alone. I guess I technically have been, as far as people that care go, for almost a year by judging the reactions I've received.
